meta.name: add-telegram
meta.description: Add Telegram channel integration via Chat SDK.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果想给应用增加聊天消息渠道
copy.tagline_en: Add Telegram chat to your existing app
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to add a chat channel to your app.

howto.what: 装上后 Claude 会把项目的 Telegram 机器人通道接好：复制适配器与辅助文件、注册适配器、安装固定版本依赖、构建并跑注册测试，再引导你用 BotFather 建机器人、填 token、重启服务，最后用 4 位配对码绑定你的聊天。
howto.when: 当你要给项目新增 Telegram 频道集成，或在 /setup、/init-first-agent、/manage-channels 里需要把 Telegram 这个通道接线时触发。

say.text: 帮我把 Telegram 通道接进项目，跑一遍构建和注册测试。
say.note: 会复制适配器并注册、装依赖后构建与测试。

say.text: 我用 BotFather 拿到 token 了，帮我存好并验证一下。
say.note: token 写入 .env，并用 getMe 验证有效性。

say.text: 开始配对，我该把 4 位配对码发到哪个聊天？
say.note: 打印 4 位码，发送成功后绑定该聊天。

howto.what_en: Claude wires the Telegram bot channel into your project: it copies the adapter and helpers, registers it, installs the pinned package, builds and runs tests, then guides bot creation, token entry, restart, and 4-digit pairing.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you want to add Telegram channel integration, or when /setup, /init-first-agent, or /manage-channels needs this channel wired up.

say_en.text: Add Telegram channel support and run the build plus registration test.
say_en.note: Copies and registers the adapter, installs the dep, then builds.

say_en.text: I have my BotFather token — store it and verify it.
say_en.note: Token goes to .env and is checked via getMe.

say_en.text: Start pairing — where do I send the 4-digit code?
say_en.note: Prints a 4-digit code; sending it binds that chat.
